channel.title: Stig's Lab Notes
channel.description: A blog focused on vulnerability research, exploit development and general security topics.

item.title: A Silly Satellite Wi-Fi Router Bug - Redport Pre-Auth RCE
item.description: Pre-auth RCE over LAN in the RedPort wXa-223 satellite Wi-Fi router, found within minutes of unpacking the firmware.

item.title: AI-Driven Binary Analysis on a TOTOLINK Router - Shooting Bugs-In-A-Barrel
item.description: Using PRIZM ZERO's AI-driven binary analysis to reproduce known CVEs and find new memory-corruption bugs in a TOTOLINK router's cstecgi.cgi.

item.title: Uncovering a 0-Click RCE in the SuperNote Nomad E-ink Tablet
item.description: Chaining a vulnerability and misconfigurations into a remotely installable, 0-click rootkit on the SuperNote Nomad E-ink tablet (CVE-2025-32409).

item.title: Rooting the FiiO M6 - Part 2 - Writing an LPE Exploit For Our Overflow Bug
item.description: Turning the FiiO M6 kernel stack overflow into a working local privilege escalation exploit.

item.title: Rooting the FiiO M6 - Part 1 - Using the "World's Worst Fuzzer" To Find A Kernel Bug
item.description: Using the world's worst fuzzer to find a kernel stack overflow in the FiiO M6's procfs debug interface.

item.title: UAF and House Of Force Fun - ROMHack CTF Swordmaster Pwn Challenge
item.description: A format string leak, a UAF heap leak, and a House of Force attack to pop a shell in the ROMHack CTF Swordmaster pwn challenge.

item.title: Wavlink Command Injection - CVE-2022-23900
item.description: An unauthenticated command injection in the Wavlink WL-WN531P3 router API, exploitable from the internet via CSRF.

item.title: JWT Confusion and SSTI - CyberSanta CTF Naughty or Nice Web Challenge
item.description: Exploiting a JWT verification flaw and an SSTI vulnerability to get RCE in the CyberSanta CTF Naughty or Nice web challenge.
